description: This file is a shell script library for common git merge and diff tool functions, handling configuration, tool detection, execution, and user interaction for merge tools within a git environment.

methods.name: mode_ok
methods.description: Checks if the current mode is either diff or merge and returns true if so.

methods.name: is_available
methods.description: Checks if a specified merge tool is available in the system.

methods.name: list_config_tools
methods.description: Lists configured tools under a specific git config section.

methods.name: show_tool_names
methods.description: Displays available tools based on conditions, both available and not currently available.

methods.name: diff_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current mode is set to diff.

methods.name: merge_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the current mode is set to merge.

methods.name: get_gui_default
methods.description: Determines whether GUI is the default for the current mode based on git configuration and environment.

methods.name: gui_mode
methods.description: Returns true if the GUI mode is enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: translate_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool, potentially translating the argument.

methods.name: check_unchanged
methods.description: Checks if the merge result is unchanged and prompts the user if needed.

methods.name: valid_tool
methods.description: Checks if a given tool is valid and executable.

methods.name: setup_user_tool
methods.description: Configures user-defined merge tools with default commands.

methods.name: setup_tool
methods.description: Initializes the environment for a specific merge tool, loading tool-specific functions and verifying availability.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_cmd
methods.description: Retrieves the command to invoke a specific merge tool from git configuration.

methods.name: trust_exit_code
methods.description: Determines if the exit code from a merge tool can be trusted to determine success.

methods.name: initialize_merge_tool
methods.description: Sets up the environment for running a specific merge tool.

methods.name: run_merge_tool
methods.description: Executes the merge or diff command for a specific tool.

methods.name: run_diff_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured diff command for a tool.

methods.name: run_merge_cmd
methods.description: Runs the configured merge command and checks if the merge was successful.

methods.name: list_merge_tool_candidates
methods.description: Provides a list of candidate tools based on environment and platform.

methods.name: show_tool_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available tools.

methods.name: guess_merge_tool
methods.description: Guesses an appropriate merge tool based on environment and available tools.

methods.name: get_configured_merge_tool
methods.description: Retrieves the merge tool configured in git settings, considering mode and environment.

methods.name: get_merge_tool_path
methods.description: Returns the path to the merge tool executable, validating its existence.

methods.name: get_merge_tool
methods.description: Determines which merge tool to use, either configured or guessed.

methods.name: mergetool_find_win32_cmd
methods.description: Locates an executable in Windows environment, checking PATH and common directories.
